acceptance_evidence: doctor --online JSON showing doctor.provider.repo_json pass and doctor.github.branch_protection evaluated with its failures list
completion_conditions: shiki doctor --json --online --target . reports doctor.provider.repo_json as pass rather than warn.
doctor.github.branch_protection is evaluated and reported instead of skipped.
non_goals: Do not change GitHub branch protection; reconciling the mismatch doctor now reports is separate work.
Do not change doctor's config-reading logic; the shiki_config/shiki_doctor parity defects are a separate goal.
outcome: The Shiki platform repository records its own provider metadata in .shiki/repo.json so 'shiki doctor --online' runs its GitHub checks instead of skipping every one of them behind doctor.github.online.
title: Make shiki doctor's online checks reachable on the Shiki platform repository
